dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: ...That's why we have a little spice-flavored bean paste before eating desserts. It completely changes the taste experience.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: For example, Rose Custard, even the kind with sugar content reduced to one-third, will taste just as sweet as before, while its floral fragrance is intensified.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Huh. The medical texts that Miss Glenfidia brought back from Nod-Krai also mentioned this...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: "Tiny amounts of spicy ingredients can activate one's sense of taste in various ways, enhancing the effects that seasonings have."

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Fontainian research also suggests that ingesting the right amounts of spicy ingredients can revitalize the body and quickly burn off extra energy.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hmm, in that case, those spicy appetizers that I brought...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: You can cut each small dried fish into two to three pieces — the perfect size for low-sugar desserts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, looks like you're getting on just great, you two!

choices.text: Was it the topic of cooking that kicked this off?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Actually, we started out by talking about our common troubles.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Tahchin's delicious, but its flavor is almost intoxicating... By the time you realize something's gone wrong, you've got several empty plates sitting in front of you.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Recently, the portions they serve at Good Hunter have gotten much bigger, and every meal is enough to leave the Knights fully satisfied. But for a member of the Church like myself...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Mmhmm.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Ahem...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait. What is this about?

choices.text: Something I occasionally worry about, too.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Haha! Perfect timing!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: And here I was hoping to butt in and say, "We'll work on losing weight starting tomorrow." Y'know, to stop the consensus from forming...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I'd already reduced the sugar and cream content in the cakes, and drawn up a healthy morning exercise plan for the next few days...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I didn't expect that you'd already found your own ways around the problem. Hah, genius!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: In that case, let's use Nilou's trick and Barbara's dried fish to have ourselves a zero-regrets-included dinner!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: D—Did you prepare all this for us?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I've also got a plate of Volcano Cake for you and Paimon! I looked up the latest recipes and adjusted the ingredients...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: ...I hope it's to your tastes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cake hand-baked by Kachina...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon will take her time savoring this for sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, wait a minute! Do you have some sorta gadget we can use to keep a small piece as a souvenir?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Oh, you can finish it all! If you'd like another one, I can make it for you, easy!

choices.text: If you say so, I'm tucking in.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Alright! I've also prepared some drinks. Remember to cut it into smaller pieces so you don't choke...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Hmm. I forget. How many dinners have we had together at this point?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I wonder. Our time together has passed slowly, yet so quickly. A fulfilling time that has passed like a dream...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hey now! I've said it before and I'll say it again—

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: "Happiness isn't short-lived if we make happy gatherings a regular thing!"

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: This is the happiest time of our lives, and there'll be more such moments to come!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You enjoy a feast with your friends. The relaxing gathering seems to have left you in a great mood, and with the abundance of exercise you've been doing while leading dances, the flavor of every dish is made impeccable...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: This goes double for Kachina's cake. The magic they call "hard work" has imparted not only sweetness, but also an immense sense of ease upon those who eat it.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Everyone makes a promise:\n"When Kachina's cake shop opens, we'll bring the best gifts to the opening ceremony!"

choices.text: In that case, I'll savor this.
Nothing that would ever give you trouble, Paimon.
Well, I guess that's one way of solving the issue.
